title: Fastest Way to Copy Winning Digital Products (Picsart)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Sponsored-style demo of Picsart AI image tools.

stated_problem.quote: you don't spend months banging your head against a wall trying to sell the same personal finance spreadsheet that 10,000 other guys are selling
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Reverse-engineered Etsy digital printables
idea.one_liner: Find hidden Etsy best-sellers (star-seller filter, swap 'star' for 'best' in URL), target shops with many sales but few SKUs, create similar designs with Picsart AI and A/B test on Facebook Marketplace/ads before listing
idea.offer: digital printables (junk journals, wall art, party games, holiday prints)
